== Set chronology and counts ==

The table counts distinct named cards in each side of the official card list checked on 13 November 2026. Alternate-image variants and multiple faces are grouped with their card. Earlier totals and current metadata differ because they count different publication entries, and the source audit retains those differences. The current Set 27 card list still lists six preview cards, so its complete printable release and official metadata support the full-release count of 28 instead.

Set P is listed once, with its second release on 30 August 2019 recorded in the date cell. Its first sheet is also distributed as the Demo Deck Premium Set. The publisher's separate Basic Demo Decks and two expansions have no checked wiki destinations yet. The combined download repeats those products.

The official release page says Set 21 was released 18 June 2023. The current official metadata says 19 June 2023. The table follows the release page.
